description: This file defines the EventHubCheckpointer class and its factory, managing checkpoint data in Azure Table Storage for EventHub stream partitions in Orleans.

classes.name: EventHubCheckpointerFactory
classes.description: Factory for creating EventHubCheckpointer instances, managing options and cluster info.

classes.name: EventHubCheckpointer
classes.description: Handles storing and retrieving EventHub partition checkpoints in Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new EventHubCheckpointer instance asynchronously.

methods.name: CreateFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory instance for checkpointers based on service provider and stream provider name.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the checkpoint offset for a partition from Azure Table Storage.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates the checkpoint offset in storage, respecting throttling to avoid excessive writes.
